user.title: Add a TV
user.description: Choose how to connect to the YouTube app on your TV.

host.title: Connect by IP address
host.description: The YouTube app must be open on the TV.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the TV.

pairing_code.title: Connect with a TV code
pairing_code.description: On the TV, open YouTube and go to Settings > Link with TV code. Enter the code shown there.

data_description.pairing_code: The 12-digit code shown on the TV. Spaces are ignored.

discovery_confirm.description: Do you want to add the YouTube app on {name}?

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to {name}
reauth_confirm.description: YouTube no longer accepts the saved connection to {name}. Open the YouTube app on the TV and select Submit to reconnect.

error.no_screen_id: The TV didn't provide a YouTube screen. Make sure the YouTube app is open on the TV, or use a TV code instead.
error.invalid_pairing_code: The TV code was not accepted. Codes expire after a few minutes; get a new one and try again.

abort.not_supported: This device doesn't expose a YouTube app

screen_revoked.message: YouTube no longer accepts the TV's screen id; reconnect the TV.

command_failed.message: Failed to send the command to the TV: {error}

invalid_video.message: "{media_id}" is not a YouTube video id or URL.
